history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Behind the wall, several cars are parked, including a dark-colored car and a small red car. The lighting appears to be natural daylight, casting soft shadows and highlighting the textures of the clothing and the background elements. The overall mood is casual and candid, with a hint of shyness or privacy conveyed by the way he's holding the cap. The image has a slightly desaturated, soft focus quality, suggesting it might be a candid photograph taken with a phone or a vintage-style camera.
